mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_find_key ( email, key_value, use_yn, expired_dt, reg_dt, mod_dt ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{keyValue}, #{useYn}, #{expiredDt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT p.key_seq, p.email, p.use_yn, p.expired_dt, p.key_value, p.reg_dt, p.mod_dt FROM password_find_key p WHERE p.email = #{email} AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE email_auth_info SET use_yn = #{useYn}, mod_dt = NOW() WHERE key_seq = #{keySeq}
